scheme_name: Talab Matsyiki Vishesh Sahayata Yojana (Anusuchit Jaati/Janajati/Ati Pichhada)
other_conditions: Applicant must have private or leased land available for pond construction.
benefits_summary: Provides a 70% subsidy on pond construction costs, disbursed 60% after construction and 40% after equipment installation.
